description: 文献分级规则。主分级由人工定义的研究范围、机制深度、模型类型和排除规则决定；检索关键词只作为证据，不直接决定等级；feedback 只用于边界样本的轻量校准。长期筛选标准仍以 research_os/文献评价/screening_standards.md 为准。

research_focus.primary_question: 待填写：你的研究方向描述，例如关注某类暴露因素与某类健康结局之间的关系。

strongly_prioritize: 待填写：你重点关注的研究类型，例如动物实验、体外机制研究等。
downgrade: 待填写：你希望降权的研究类型，例如缺乏机制深度的观察性研究等。
strict_exclude: 待填写：你希望严格排除的内容，例如与研究方向完全无关的领域等。

A.definition: Directly matches the configured core research scope with strong mechanism or experimental evidence.
typical_cases: Animal experiments with mammalian disease models
In vitro mechanism studies with functional validation
A.action: High priority for inclusion and detailed review.

B.definition: Clearly related to the configured topic or adjacent subfield, but not fully core.
typical_cases: Adjacent subfield research with experimental design
B.action: Include for monitoring; review when time permits.

C.definition: Broad field relevance with low short-term priority.
typical_cases: Large cohort studies with observational design
C.action: Low priority; may include in periodic summary.
